ishaan: FYI intermittent onboarding break: web sample shows "Unexpected end of JSON input" when streaming long completions. Happens ~1/7 runs. go/python clients fine.
mei: repro steps? where's the harness?
ishaan: examples/onboard/stream-streamlit. Start proxy + page, feed long prompt. Browser console: EventSource.onerror then UI parse error. Logs: see below.
ishaan: ```
[2026-03-24T08:11:02.001Z] runtime: emit seq=21 data='{"chunk":"..."'
[2026-03-24T08:11:02.002Z] runtime: keepalive (blank event)
[2026-03-24T08:11:02.003Z] proxy: aborted request -> CRLF injected
[2026-03-24T08:11:02.004Z] runtime: emit seq=22 data='", "more": 1 }'
[2026-03-24T08:11:02.005Z] browser: EventSource.onerror -> close
```
claire: sounds like the browser treats the injected blank event + onerror as stream end. Node/go clients have different SSE libs and buffer across that.
mei: short-term mitigations: 1) sample-app add an sseReassembler helper that buffers chunk data and only JSON.parse when complete; 2) debounce heartbeats (50-150ms) so transient empty events don't trigger finalization; 3) add opt-in grace window before treating onerror as terminal in the web helper.
ishaan: agreed. Also update DX docs: "Streaming pitfalls" with note about proxies normalizing CRLFs and varying EventSource behavior across runtimes.
claire: longer-term: runtime should emit named events (event: keepalive / event: final) so clients can unambiguously detect finalization. That avoids relying on empty-data semantics.
ishaan: also add a tiny parity test matrix in CI that runs the sample-app harness against node/go/python SDK clients and a headless browser with simulated CRLF injects.
sdk-bot: CI: ran 10/10 with reassembler+debounce on branch; baseline was 8/10.
infra-bot: INFRA-2201 filed to trace proxy CRLF on abort path and add logging.
mei: I'll open PRs: web-sample helper + README note. Claire can follow-up with runtime RFC for explicit event names.
claire: will draft RFC, include backwards compatible switch. Also add a tiny telemetry event so we can measure keepalive vs data rates per client to correlate flakes.
ishaan: thanks team. Plan: land sample-app fix today, add docs, pair with infra ticket. Leaving TODO to audit SDKs for parity and add helper libs in official SDKs. :white_check_mark:
